name: mind binding
author: 77mango
description: Enter the bottom of the gravity portal at 47.8% and then quickly quick twice so your icon goes near the spikes at 48.3% (this makes it so your icon skips the trigger that disables your controls) and then shortly after, you can start spamming above the level. Continue spamming until the camera pans away from your icon where you can then release. Free to the end from there.
